items.detail: ★ 原文重點（全文很短，重點都在這裡）：「First Mid-Term Examination（第一次期中考）／時間(Time): 10/21 (Wednesday). 19:00-21:00 ／*記得攜帶計算機&學生證*」。　★ 三個必須注意的細節：**第一，是晚上的考試，不是正課時間** —— 19:00–21:00 代表那天白天的課照上，等於整個 10/21 從早到晚都被佔滿，當天不要再排任何打工、補教或出遊。**第二，明文要求攜帶計算機與學生證** —— 成大工程類科目通常禁用手機計算機、且入場要查證，計算機沒電或忘記帶在現場是沒有替代方案的，建議這週就先確認計算機能開機、必要時換電池。**第三，這是「第一次」期中考**，意味著學期內還會有第二次，所以這次的成績權重與考法（是否開書、是否給公式表）值得主動問清楚。　★ 同一個公佈欄在 20:54 另外發了一則「助教 Office hour」：office 93B56、office hour 每週四 15:00–16:00、助教信箱 n36154512@gs.ncku.edu.tw。**今天就是週四** —— 如果你對熱力學第一章到目前進度有任何卡住的地方，今天下午 15:00–16:00 是距離考試最近、最便宜的一次一對一機會，而且下一次要等到 10/15，再下一次就只剩考前五天的 10/15 之後了。建議今天去之前先把看不懂的 2–3 題寫在紙上帶過去。

items.en: Israel marks three years since the October 7 attack as strikes continue in Gaza
items.zh: 以色列紀念 10/7 攻擊三週年，加薩空襲聲中舉行悼念
items.summary: Israel held memorials three years after the Hamas attack that killed about 1,200 people and took 251 hostages. Mourners gathered near Kibbutz Reim in the south, close enough to Gaza that airstrikes could be heard during the ceremony. At the state memorial in Jerusalem, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu did not address reports that he had ignored warnings of a planned Hamas operation. A bereaved father, Yaakov Godo, interrupted him from the audience, saying Netanyahu had failed to protect his son. Separately, at least three Palestinians were reported killed in Gaza the same day, including a 16-year-old near Khan Younis.

items.en: More than 250,000 students and teachers march across France in largest protest yet
items.zh: 法國學生教師逾 25 萬人遊行，為本波抗議規模最大的一天
items.summary: More than 250,000 people marched in over 40 French cities, the largest turnout since high school students began blockading their schools more than two weeks ago. Protesters are demanding action on staff shortages, overcrowded classrooms and decaying school buildings. Paris alone drew roughly 56,000 marchers. Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu said at least 215 teenagers and 85 staff members were injured in clashes with police, a figure that has intensified criticism of the police response rather than calming it. The movement is now one of the largest student mobilisations France has seen in years.

items.en: Paramount Skydance completes $111 billion Warner Bros. Discovery takeover
items.zh: 派拉蒙 Skydance 完成 1,110 億美元併購華納兄弟探索，CNN 與 CBS News 同屬一家
items.summary: Paramount Skydance closed its $111 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery, creating a media group that will operate under the name Skydance. The combined company now owns both CNN and CBS News, placing two major American news organisations under a single owner for the first time. Chief executive David Ellison is reported to receive a $150 million payday from the deal. The transaction is one of the largest media consolidations in decades and is expected to draw continued scrutiny over newsroom independence and the concentration of broadcast news ownership.

items.en: Houthi drones and missiles strike Aden airport as Yemen offensive intensifies
items.zh: 胡塞武裝無人機與飛彈襲擊亞丁機場，擊中航廈與跑道
items.summary: Houthi forces fired drones and missiles at Aden International Airport in Yemen, hitting a passenger terminal and a runway only minutes before a flight to Cairo was due to depart. Saudi officials separately said they had intercepted a Houthi missile north of Riyadh on the same day. The attacks came as Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces pressed an offensive to retake the remaining Houthi-held territory, including the capital Sana'a. The strike on a civilian airport marks an escalation in a conflict that had recently been concentrated on front-line positions rather than transport infrastructure.

items.en: India opposition leaders detained protesting removal of 130 million names from voter rolls
items.zh: 印度反對黨領袖抗議 1.3 億選民名單被刪遭拘留
items.summary: Indian police detained several opposition leaders and dispersed a protest led by Rahul Gandhi of the Congress Party against a nationwide purge that removed 130 million names from the electoral rolls. The crackdown followed demonstrations by a Gen Z-led movement in Mumbai and Delhi calling for Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar to resign. The scale of the deletion, affecting roughly a tenth of India's registered electorate, has turned a technical revision of voter lists into a central political dispute ahead of upcoming elections, with opposition parties alleging the process disenfranchises their supporters.

items.en: Anthropic launches Claude Haiku 5.5 at roughly 75% below the previous Haiku price
items.zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Haiku 5.5，價格比 Haiku 4.5 便宜約 75%
items.summary: Anthropic released Claude Haiku 5.5 at $0.10 per million input tokens and $0.50 per million output tokens, roughly 75% below the pricing of Haiku 4.5. The model scores 72.4% on the OSWorld 2.1 computer-use benchmark, a level previously associated with larger and more expensive models. The same announcement halved Sonnet 5.5 cache-read pricing from $0.20 to $0.10 per million tokens. The move continues a pattern of frontier labs pushing small-model costs down sharply, which matters most for high-volume automation and agent workloads rather than one-off chat use.

items.en: OpenAI begins rolling GPT-6 into ChatGPT with an interactive 'Intelligent UI'
items.zh: OpenAI 開始在 ChatGPT 推出 GPT-6，新增可互動的圖表與計算器介面
items.summary: OpenAI started rolling GPT-6 into ChatGPT together with a feature it calls Intelligent UI, which renders interactive charts, forms and calculators directly inside a conversation instead of returning static text. Paid tiers receive the update first, with Free and Go users scheduled to follow on October 8. The same day, Reuters reported OpenAI's first teen usage study, which found median teen use of under 15 minutes a day, while Common Sense Media rated ChatGPT for Teens an 'Unacceptable Risk' after more than 4,000 prompt tests. OpenAI disputed that methodology.

items.en: Finland orders Google subsidiary to halt data centre groundwork at two sites
items.zh: 芬蘭當局命令 Google 子公司停止兩處資料中心整地工程
items.summary: Finland's Permit and Supervision Agency ordered Tuike Finland, a Google subsidiary, to suspend land-altering work at its Muhos and Kajaani data centre sites. The company must respond by October 14 and stop the work by October 23. Google said the activity 'fell short of our own high standards.' The order lands the same week Google contracted 3,590 MW of power from Constellation Energy, about a quarter of it from new nuclear capacity with first deliveries in 2028, underlining how the physical constraints of AI build-out, land use, permits and electricity, are now as binding as chip supply.

items.en: MLB Division Series reach Game 3 as Guardians visit White Sox in an all-AL-Central matchup
items.zh: MLB 分區系列賽進入第三戰，守護者作客白襪的美聯中區內戰
items.summary: The 2026 Major League Baseball postseason reached the Division Series stage, with an all-AL Central matchup sending the Cleveland Guardians to Chicago to face the White Sox in Game 3 on October 7. Both American and National League Division Series are being played as best-of-five, so Game 3 is the first point at which a team can move within one win of advancing to the Championship Series. The White Sox reaching October at all is the more surprising half of this pairing given the franchise's recent rebuilding years.

items.en: Webull shares slide about 20% after a congressional report on its China ties
items.zh: Webull 股價盤中重挫約 20%，起因是國會針對其中國關係的報告
items.summary: Shares of brokerage Webull fell roughly 20% during the October 7 session after a congressional report examined the company's ties to China. The stock was on track for its worst single-day decline since April 2025. The move stood out on a day when the major indexes fell only modestly, making it the clearest single-stock story of the session. For anyone holding retail-brokerage or crypto-adjacent names, the episode is a reminder that regulatory and political risk can reprice a stock far faster than earnings do.

items.en: Champions League 2026-27 league phase continues into its October fixtures
items.zh: 2026-27 歐冠聯賽階段進入十月賽程
items.summary: The 2026-27 UEFA Champions League is in its league-phase stage, the expanded single-table format in which every club plays eight different opponents before the standings decide who advances directly and who enters a knockout play-off round. October fixtures are where early results start to separate the teams likely to finish in the automatic qualification places from those heading for the play-off. Because the table is shared across all participating clubs, a single dropped result now carries more weight on goal difference than it did under the old group system.

items.en: People shift their political opinions to match the room in small group chats
items.zh: 研究：在小型群組討論中，人們會把政治立場調整成跟群體一致
items.summary: A study published October 6 found that participants in small group discussions adjusted their stated political views to align with the other people in the conversation. The effect appeared in ordinary chat-sized groups rather than large crowds, which is the setting most people actually argue politics in. The finding is a practical caution for anyone reading consensus in a seminar, a group project or a group chat as evidence of what people independently believe: apparent agreement may partly be the room shaping the answers rather than the answers converging on their own.

items.en: Brain scans reveal opposite reward responses in ADHD and autism
items.zh: 腦部掃描顯示 ADHD 與自閉症的獎勵反應方向相反
items.summary: Neuroimaging research published October 6 reported that reward-related brain responses run in opposite directions in ADHD and autism, rather than differing only in degree. The result matters because the two conditions are frequently discussed together and sometimes co-diagnosed, which can lead to a single assumed profile of motivation. If reward processing genuinely diverges, then strategies built around incentives, deadlines or novelty may help one group while actively working against the other, and study or teaching advice aimed at 'neurodivergent learners' as one category is likely too coarse.

items.en: Salsa dancing eased depressive symptoms in young adults, randomized trial finds
items.zh: 隨機對照試驗：跳騷莎舞能減輕年輕成人的憂鬱症狀
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial published October 6 found that salsa dancing reduced depressive symptoms in young adults. The randomized design is what makes it notable: most studies linking dance or exercise to mood are observational and cannot separate the activity from the kind of person who takes it up. The result adds to evidence that structured physical activity with a social component outperforms solitary exercise for mood, which is a relevant detail for university students, where the social half of the intervention is usually the part that is hardest to arrange alone.

items.en: Anthropic cuts small-model pricing and expands its Cyber Verification Program into three tiers
items.zh: Anthropic 降價並把資安驗證計畫擴充為三層，夥伴四個月找出逾 12.9 萬個漏洞
items.summary: Anthropic followed the Claude Haiku 5.5 price cut by expanding its Cyber Verification Program into three tiers and folding in Project Glasswing. Partners in the programme reportedly identified more than 129,000 verified software flaws between April and July 2026. Separately, Elon Musk said SpaceX's Grok Bot will route tasks to whichever back-end model suits them best, naming Claude Opus 5.5 for heavy reasoning and coding work, an unusually explicit case of one AI product publicly delegating its hardest workloads to a competitor's model.

items.en: SpaceX in talks to raise $40 billion to buy Nvidia chips; Musk to build $16.8B Texas fab himself
items.zh: SpaceX 傳洽談籌資 400 億美元購買 Nvidia 晶片；馬斯克將自建 168 億美元德州晶圓廠
items.summary: SpaceX is reported to be in talks to raise $40 billion to purchase chips from Nvidia, a figure comparable to the annual capital spending of a large chipmaker. Separately, Musk said his companies will build and operate the $16.8 billion Terafab plant in Texas themselves, with TSMC potentially leasing part of the site and Intel remaining the process partner on its 14A node. For the watchlist, this touches SPCX, NVDA, INTC and TSMC at once, and suggests AI compute demand is now being financed at the scale of national infrastructure projects rather than corporate IT budgets.

items.en: Nvidia research cuts trillion-parameter RL weight sync from 87 minutes to 150 seconds
items.zh: Nvidia 新論文把兆級參數強化學習的權重同步從約 87 分鐘縮短到 150 秒
items.summary: An Nvidia paper described NeMo-DCR, a technique that reduces weight synchronisation time for a one-trillion-parameter reinforcement-learning model from roughly 87.5 minutes to about 150 seconds, a reduction of around 97%. Synchronisation overhead is one of the practical limits on how fast very large models can be trained with RL, so a change of this size affects iteration speed rather than just cost. In the same week Microsoft opened preorders for its Surface RTX Spark Dev Box at $5,999, built on Nvidia's RTX Spark superchip with 128GB of unified memory, shipping in November.

items.en: Mrs. GREEN APPLE released 6th album 'POPS' and are touring arenas for the first time in three years
items.zh: Mrs. GREEN APPLE 第六張專輯《POPS》已於 9/30 發行，並展開三年來首次巡迴巨蛋／體育館公演
items.summary: Mrs. GREEN APPLE released their sixth original full album POPS on September 30, 2026, which the band has framed as the opening of its 'Phase 3'. The release came with a new key visual and the announcement of their first nationwide arena tour in about three years. As of early October the tour is under way, and the band is handing out a free printed 'travel pamphlet' at venues. Taiwan and Hong Kong dates have not been announced for this run, so for now it remains a Japan-domestic tour.

items.en: Mrs. GREEN APPLE release the music video for new song 'Kyohan'
items.zh: Mrs. GREEN APPLE 公開新曲〈共犯〉MV，色彩繽紛的世界走向意料之外的發展
items.summary: Mrs. GREEN APPLE published the music video for their new song Kyohan, described as a happy, colourful world whose story takes an unexpected turn. The track follows the POPS album cycle and continues the band's pattern of pairing bright arrangements with narrative videos that undercut the surface mood. For anyone learning Japanese through lyrics, this one is useful: the title itself is a two-kanji compound meaning accomplice, and the song's vocabulary sits in everyday register rather than the heavily literary wording some of their earlier singles used.

items.en: YOASOBI running the first Asia 10-city dome and stadium tour by a Japanese act
items.zh: YOASOBI 進行日本藝人首次的亞洲十城巨蛋暨體育場巡迴（2026-2027）
items.summary: YOASOBI are staging the YOASOBI ASIA 10-CITY DOME & STADIUM TOUR 2026-2027, billed as the first Asian dome-and-stadium tour on this scale by a Japanese artist. The run spans ten cities across Asia and uses dome or stadium-sized venues throughout rather than the arena circuit most J-pop acts tour overseas. For fans in Taiwan and Hong Kong this is the relevant tour to watch for local dates, and because dome shows in this region typically sell in a single lottery round, the registration window matters more than the general sale date.

items.en: King Gnu's CEN+RAL Tour 2026 covered Taipei, Hong Kong, Bangkok, Shanghai and Seoul
items.zh: King Gnu「CEN+RAL Tour 2026」巡迴含台北小巨蛋 6/6–6/7（已結束），亞洲場另有香港、曼谷、上海、首爾
items.summary: King Gnu's CEN+RAL Tour 2026 was the band's largest city count to date, running from February 2026 through Sendai, Osaka, Takamatsu, Tokyo, Nagoya, Hiroshima, Chiba, Fukuoka, Sapporo and Niigata in Japan, then Bangkok, Hong Kong, Taipei, Shanghai and Seoul. The Taipei Arena shows took place on June 6 and 7, 2026 with tickets from NT$800 to NT$5,880, and have already finished. Worth noting for next time: the band ran an official fan-club viewing package for the Taipei and Seoul dates that bundled ticket, flight and hotel.

market.highlight: ★★★ 今天開盤前只要記住三件事：**①台股 49,806.37（-16.18 點、-0.03%），五萬點第三天沒過，而且這次連「價」都停了** —— 盤中最高 49,966.89 距五萬只剩 33 點卻收黑，成交金額再從週二的 9,759 億縮到 9,259 億（又縮約 5%，連兩天萎縮）。**②真正在漲的錢換了跑道** —— 權值股熄火（台積電約持平、聯發科 -0.2%、鴻海 -0.78%），但塑化股 +4.56%、泥窯股 +3.88%、紡織股 +2.03%、金融股 +1.02%，漲停集中在被動元件（華新科鎖漲停 428 元）、矽光子（光聖 +8%、連亞 +7%）與傳產（南亞漲停）—— 這三個族群**全都不在你的 75 檔觀察清單裡**。**③美股昨夜從新高回落，但重點不是股價而是殖利率** —— 10 年期美債殖利率盤中衝到 5.36%，是 2002 年 4 月以來最高，道瓊 -0.66%、S&P 500 -0.22%、那斯達克 -0.22%，小型股 Russell 2000 -1.31% 跌最兇，半導體 ETF（SMH／SOXX）各跌約 1%。
market.note: ★ 今天三條主線：　①【台股：五萬點第三度叩關失敗，而且量價一起退】加權指數 49,806.37，跌 16.18 點（-0.03%），開盤 49,857.32、盤中最高 49,966.89（距五萬點僅 33 點）、最低 49,567.52，成交金額 9,259.92 億元、成交 1,021.5 萬張。不含金融股指數 44,574.73（-55.77 點）。漲跌家數 595 漲／394 跌／114 平 —— **注意這個組合：指數收黑但上漲家數是下跌家數的 1.5 倍**，代表指數的黑K完全是權值股造成的，中小型股其實多數在漲。這就是為什麼今天盤面感覺熱、指數卻不動。　②【資金從電子權值轉進傳產與被動元件】八大類股：塑化 +4.56%、泥窯 +3.88%、紡織 +2.03%、造紙 +1.63%、食品 +1.53%、營建 +1.29%、金融 +1.02%，只有機電股 -0.42%。漲幅前五名是光聖、兆聯實業、志超、台塑、騰輝電子-KY；跌幅前五名是川湖、松川精密、穎崴、巨鎧精密-創、德淵 —— **川湖（2059）在你的觀察清單「機構件」裡，而它是今天跌幅前五**，這是清單內最需要留意的一檔。成交量前五是友達、主動中信台灣收益、聯電、主動統一升級50、群益臺灣加權正2，兩檔主動式 ETF 與一檔正2進入成交量前五，是散戶與槓桿資金仍在場的訊號。　③【美股：殖利率才是主角】道瓊 51,179.87（-341.41 點、-0.66%）、S&P 500 7,801.77（-17.16 點、-0.22%）、那斯達克綜合 27,538.69（-61.20 點、-0.22%）、那斯達克 100 31,160.08（-0.2%）、Russell 2000 2,793.20（-37.09 點、-1.31%）。10 年期殖利率收 5.28%、盤中觸及 5.36%（2002 年 4 月以來最高），30 年期收 5.66%、盤中 5.73%。QQQ、SPY、VGT 各 -0.2%，DIA -0.7%，SMH 與 SOXX 各約 -1%。NVDA 與 AMD 都只從歷史高點小跌不到 1%。**解讀：這不是 AI 行情結束，是資金成本上升在壓估值** —— 殖利率衝到 2002 年以來最高時，先受傷的永遠是沒有現金流的小型股（Russell 2000 -1.31%）與高估值半導體，而不是大型權值。

movers.name: ⚠️ 先說清楚這一區今天的資料基準，以及和昨天最大的不同
movers.reason: ★ **今天這一區和昨天最大的差別：漲幅 ≥5% 的標的幾乎全部在你的 75 檔觀察清單之外。** 昨天（10/06）清單內有 4 檔 ≥5%（緯穎、世芯-KY、台光電、MRVL）；今天清單內一檔都沒有確認的 ≥5%，但盤面上至少有 8–10 檔漲停或漲逾 5%，全部集中在三個你沒在追的族群：**被動元件、矽光子、塑化傳產**。　★ 這代表什麼：你的清單是一份「AI 基建清單」（AI 伺服器、散熱、CCL、ASIC、記憶體），而 10/07 的資金剛好從這條主軸撤出、跑去補漲落後的傳產與零組件。清單沒有錯，但它今天看不到盤面的熱點 —— 所以下面前四筆我特別把**清單外的新熱門標的放在最上方**。　★ 另一個必須提醒的資料限制：10/07 的個股「收盤」漲跌幅，公開來源多只給到漲停／漲逾 X% 的描述，沒有逐檔精確收盤百分比。因此下面標示「漲停」的以 +10% 計、標示「漲逾 X%」的以該門檻計，**均屬示意，請以下單平台為準**。

movers.name: 🔥 清單外新熱門①　華新科
movers.reason: **被動元件族群的今日領頭羊，亮燈漲停鎖死在 428 元。** 同族群連動：國巨（2327）655 元、+4.8%（差一點也 ≥5%）、光頡與鈺鎧率先亮燈、千如／金山電／蜜望實／今展科／立隆電／大毅漲逾 4–5%、凱美與興勤漲逾 2%，信昌電（6173）則因故暫停交易。　★ 為什麼值得你注意：被動元件（MLCC、電阻、電容）是 AI 伺服器與高速運算的**上游零組件**，和你清單裡的散熱（奇鋐、雙鴻）、PCB／CCL（台光電、金像電）其實是同一條供應鏈的不同環節，只是你的清單完全沒有涵蓋這一段。當 AI 伺服器需求往上游擴散時，被動元件通常是**最後發動、但彈性最大**的一棒。　★ 風險：被動元件是典型的高beta族群，漲停常伴隨隔日高檔震盪，這不是建議、只是族群性格的描述。

movers.name: 🔥 清單外新熱門②　光聖
movers.price: 漲逾 8%（當日漲幅前五第一名）
movers.reason: **矽光子（Silicon Photonics）族群今日最強，同時是上市漲幅前五名的第一名。** 同族群：連亞 3,135 元、漲逾 7%；IET-KY 漲逾 6%；上詮漲逾 4%；波若威與華星光漲逾 3%。　★ 為什麼這個族群今天爆發：矽光子解決的是 AI 資料中心裡「電訊號傳輸距離與功耗」的瓶頸 —— 當 GPU 叢集規模從機櫃級擴到資料中心級，銅線撐不住，就必須換光。這和昨夜 SpaceX 傳洽談籌資 400 億美元買 Nvidia 晶片、以及 Nvidia 把兆級參數訓練同步時間從 87 分鐘壓到 150 秒是同一個故事的兩端：**叢集越大，光通訊越不可或缺**。　★ 和你清單的關係：你清單裡有「衛星通訊」（IRDM）和「AI半導體」（AVGO、MRVL 都有光通訊業務），但沒有任何一檔純矽光子台廠。這是今天盤面上你清單最明顯的缺口。

movers.name: 🔥 清單外新熱門③　南亞
movers.price: 漲停（近期自 223 元漲至 322 元、波段約 +44%）
